verdict.rationale: There is no evidence that ScrapingBee publishes a machine-readable API spec. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt docs index and per-API .txt files are LLM-oriented prose documentation, not an OpenAPI-equivalent schema, so they count only as an adjacent feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
